:::{#def-binary-classification}
#### Binary classification

A **binary classification problem** is a [classification problem](#def-classification)
whose set of [classes](#def-class) $\scrC$ consists of $K = 2$ distinct categories,
one representing the presence of a condition of interest ($k_1$)
and the other representing its absence ($k_0$):

$$\scrC = \set{k_1, k_0}, \quad \abs{\scrC} = 2$$ {#eq-binary-classification}

Source: @wikipedia_statistical_classification.
:::
